notes.zh-CN: 输入框新增「优化提示词」：用已安装的 CLI 一键改写草稿，可取消、恢复原文或重试；输入框支持自定义撤销/重做（Cmd/Ctrl+Z）。APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅可安装到该团队已注册设备。
notes.en: New composer “Optimize prompt”: rewrite your draft with an installed CLI in one click, with cancel, restore, and retry. Custom undo/redo in the composer (Cmd/Ctrl+Z). APK is debug-signed; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
